notes.title: DLC Introduction - Boost DLC vol.1&2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/9a870dc3444da37ec0d3ccdd89857fd9f6db6961.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Introducing Boost DLC Vol.1&2![/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805120"][/dynamiclink][b]Boost DLC Vol.1[/b] includes the following benefits:[/p][list][*][p]Unlock all 9 types of Level 1 Boosts[/p][p][b]Energy Boost 1[/b]: Every 3rd click you get 1 more Energy(♥)[/p][p][b]Gem Boost 1[/b]: When clicked, the chance of obtaining Gem is doubled.[/p][p][b]Valuables Boost 1[/b]: Your chances of getting valuables by clicking are doubled.[/p][p][b]Gashapon Boost 1[/b]: Your chances of getting gashapon by clicking are doubled.[/p][p][b]Photo Boost 1[/b]: When combining photos, there is a 25% chance to not consume valuables and Gem[/p][p][b]Map Boost 1[/b]: 25% chance to not consume Energy(♥) when moving around the map.[/p][p][b]Action Boost 1[/b]: When you spend Energy(♥) by clicking, there is a 25% chance that no Energy(♥) will be consumed.[/p][p][b]Lucky Boost 1[/b]: Energy(♥) and Gem obtained from Gashapon are doubled.[/p][p][b]Offline Boost 1[/b]: Offline rewards double your chance of obtaining rare Gashapon shard.[/p][/*][*][p]Permanent effect on all save files with a single purchase[/p][/*][*][p]At least [b]25%[/b] cheaper than buying them individually[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805130"][/dynamiclink][b]Boost DLC Vol.2[/b] includes the following benefits:[/p][list][*][p]Unlock all 9 types of Level 2 Boosts[/p][p][b]Energy Boost 2[/b]: When you click to gain Energy(♥), you gain 1 more Energy(♥)[/p][p][b]Gem Boost 2[/b]: When you click to get Gem, you get 1 more Gem[/p][p][b]Valuables Boost 2[/b]: Your chances of getting rare valuables by clicking are doubled.[/p][p][b]Gashapon Boost 2[/b]: When you click to get a gashapon, you get 1 more of the same gashapon.[/p][p][b]Photo Boost 2[/b]: When combining photos, you only spend half as much valuables and Gem[/p][p][b]Map Boost 2[/b]: Only half Energy(♥) are consumed when moving around the map.[/p][p][b]Action Boost 2[/b]: If you spend Energy(♥) on a click, your next click will be free.[/p][p][b]Lucky Boost 2[/b]: Your chances of getting a photo from Gashapon are doubled.[/p][p][b]Offline Boost 2[/b]: All Gashapon shard obtained as offline rewards are doubled.[/p][/*][*][p]Permanent effect on all save files with a single purchase[/p][/*][*][p]At least [b]20%[/b] cheaper than buying them individually[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]The revenue from boosts and DLC is a great help in allowing me to continue developing the game.[/i][/p][p][i]I sincerely appreciate your love, interest, and support for the game.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Tip: About Gem and Gashapon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/5161e5824aeece14a0cd91890b3cc91c4bc0c38e.png[/img]

Gems can usually be obtained by clicking, with a base probability of 1/777.

Gems are mainly used when combining photos.

[i](You can increase the probability or amount of acquisition by purchasing Gem Boost.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/225a717735d7cba44746e8396c494467eafd5f84.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/e781af9c3b8c13725cf34229b7d40c848e893fda.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/7d9953b8195e6a33d7e965a4b7cb2d8362ac7c46.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/faf917291a83ea74d24af2a780c62ba92aec25a2.png[/img]

Gashapon can be obtained by clicking on it or by collecting and exchanging Gashapon Shard.

The higher the grade of Gashapon, the lower the probability of obtaining it.

Using Gashapon you can get Gem, Energy(♥) or Photos.

The photos you can get are different for each Gashapon, and these photos can only be obtained from Gashapon.

[i](You can increase the probability or amount of obtaining Gashapon by purchasing a Gashapon Boost.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/6084e46a9d0b9a588e77cff9403ce31504b38c08.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/ae65baf59375fe8123898e67fe4e6cf8752aaa9a.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/263b74012a57f72925484cebb61426bedcc129c7.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032076/837e019f68b7ebbbf504ebce10d2cede33ed1867.png[/img]

Gashapon Shard can be obtained based on the offline time between quitting and relaunching the game.

The grade and probability of obtainable Gashapon Shard gradually increase depending on the amount of time you remain offline.

The minimum offline time is 1-2 hours, and the probabilities are:
Green Gashapon Shard (1/96)
Red Gashapon Shard (1/160)
Yellow Gashapon Shard (1/256)
If not, you get a White Gashapon Shard.

The maximum offline time is 72 hours, and the probabilities are:
Green Gashapon Shard (1/3)
Red Gashapon Shard (1/5)
Yellow Gashapon Shard (1/8)
If not, you get a White Gashapon Shard.

[i](You can increase the probability or amount of obtaining Gashapon Shard by purchasing Offline Boost.)[/i]

notes.title: Limited event “Fantasy” is underway!
notes.content:
The limited-time event map “Fantasy” is now available.

Entering the event map requires 500 Energy(♥).
Clicking on the event map requires 1 Energy(♥).

The items and photos you can get from the event map are as follows.

Spear (1/400)
Sword (1/3200)
Dart (1/6500)

Spear → Lancer Photo
Sword → Knight photo
Dart → Assassin Photo

The event will run for two weeks until July 4, 2024.
